title: A Spacetime-Diffeomorphic Approach to Magnetohydrodynamics around Black Holes: Dilation Covariance, Linearization,and the No-Hair Limit
summary: The ideal magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) system that governs a conducting plasma---the Maxwell equations together with the conservation laws of mass, momentum and energy---is the same local balance structure that describes hot accretion flows around black holes. We introduce a uniform four-dimensional spacetime dilation \[ Φ_L:\;(t',x',y',z')\mapsto (t,x,y,z)=(Lt',Lx',Ly',Lz'),\qquad L>1, \] and show that it is a smooth, orientation-preserving $C^\infty$ diffeomorphism of flat spacetime.
